reason: A Zotero integration primarily focused on searching a local research library and reading bibliographic metadata, notes, attachments, and PDF full text, with optional workspace downloads and limited note-management attempts.

summaries.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API 检索文献库、读取条目与 PDF 全文、管理附件和查询笔记。
summaries.en: Search a local Zotero library, read item metadata and PDF full text, inspect attachments, and query notes through the Zotero local API.

capabilities: Queries a locally running Zotero library through its local API
Reads item metadata, abstracts, notes, collections, and cached or local PDF full text
Lists attachment paths and downloads PDF attachments to a workspace
Attempts note creation, append, update, or deletion, subject to Zotero local API limitations
